name: IL-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Democratic-leaning district (D+5) in a favorable environment for the party
Melissa Bean benefits from over $5.4 million in outside support, dwarfing Republican spending
Open seat with no incumbent on the ballot removes the usual incumbency cushion
Prediction markets price the Democrat near 94%
model.rationale: The district's Democratic lean, a favorable national environment, and Bean's overwhelming financial advantage from outside groups point to a comfortable Democratic hold, and markets agree at roughly 94%. The open-seat nature and absence of any polling are the only reasons to shade below a Safe rating.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Jennifer Davis closing the gap, or a shift in the national environment, would be the signal to move this toward a narrower race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Raja Krishnamoorthi (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Raja Krishnamoorthi's retirement leaves this Chicago-area seat open, but the district leans Democratic by five points and the political environment favors the party this cycle. Melissa Bean, a former congresswoman, has raised about $2.1 million and benefits from more than $5.4 million in outside support, while Republican Jennifer Davis has raised about $1.5 million with no reported outside backing.

Prediction markets price the Democrat near 94%, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on fundamentals and spending, pointing to a Democratic hold in the Likely range rather than fully Safe.
